mentions.name: notespace
mentions.description: Forum software designed to stay inside Cloudflare's free plan (Workers, D1, R2) for hosting small forums of a couple hundred users, with AI-powered moderation. Written mostly in Rust as Cloudflare Workers WASM, it can also self-host as a single binary with SQLite, released under the MIT license.
mentions.problem: Hosting small forums affordably within Cloudflare's free plan and defending against bot infestation; the author is still working out a good defense to the bot-infestation problem.
mentions.source_excerpt:
trying to target and stay inside Cloudflare's free plan (workers, D1, R2 etc.) for hosting small simple forums of a couple hundred users. Along with AI-powered moderation.

JS-ful in some parts - but mostly Rust cloudflare workers WASM. It can self-host as well in a single binary + sqlite. MIT.

Trying to figure out a good defense to the bot-infestation problem next.
mentions.author: kbaker
